brief:
Settlers from the "Ma'ayan Chaim" outpost published footage documenting their seizure of Palestinian olive harvest, according to Eye on Palestine. The video appears to show the settlers taking olives from Palestinian land, creating direct evidence of the activity.

The outpost is among Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Olive harvesting is a significant agricultural practice for Palestinians, particularly during the autumn season when the crop matures.
dek: In a blatant documentation of their violations, settlers from the “Ma’ayan Chaim” outpost published footage showing their plunder of the Palestinian olive harvest.
title: Israeli settlers plunder Palestinian olive harvest on video
